Great restaurant
Jan 2019 • Couples
We ate here twice as it was located close to our hotel which is a partner hotel to the one it’s located in.
Both visits we were the only people in...which is a great shame as the food was spot on. 
So if you staying close by please support it!
The restaurant itself is nicely decorated and clean & with a few more people I’m sure it would have a nice ambiance.
The food was lovely...beef with rice noodles (so good I had it twice) and hubby had beef fillet & stir fried beef...we asked for extra veg, which they included at no extra charge...thank you! 
The only criticism was the service...as slow to check on whether we wanted drinks refilled & no offer of a dessert on our first visit. The waitress was lovely but I guess as it was so quiet she’d almost forgot we were there...or possibly had something far more interesting on her phone to attend too (which I disturbed her from) 
Highly recommend & prices are very reasonable too.

Good food with a bit of class
Oct 2018 • Couples
Was caught in a heavy downpour on Monday night. Feeling reluctant to venture out into the dirty street in the rain, we settled to try our hotel Salmon Run restaurant food. Was surprised that the food we ordered “Fried Rice with Chicken Leg, Carbonara, Chicken and Corn soup and Black hot coffee with condensed milk” was actually not bad. The portion was pretty on the large side and we had sure a full meal. Managed to obtain a 10% discount as we went on a day tour through the hotel travel desk earlier. Worth to try out this restaurant if you are lacking ideas on where to eat. Price of course is on the high side compared to the local food.

High end food at mid-range prices
Oct 2017 • Family
Admittedly, we were staying at Hanoi Emerald Waters Hotel, that hosts the Salmon Run Restaurant, and having decided not to go out for dinner we were not disappointed. The menu has a wide range of high quality options focusing on Vietnamese cuisine, but with plenty of variety (seafood and meat) and alternatives. There is an extensive drinks menu and a wine list that is varied and at expected prices for Hanoi ($25+/bottle). After ordering, we did have quite a wait for our food (i.e. longer than expected consider the number of customers present), but I have to say it was worth the wait. All courses were well received and enjoyed by all the family (including kids aged 9 & 6). Staff were friendly and communicative. This location is convenient (i.e. two minute walk) from weekend evening activities around Ho Hoan Kiem lake.
